text:
Priya (PM): filing a PRD intake for a customer-triggered scope negotiation flow. need a concise problem statement + must-have acceptance criteria so we can triage.
Alex (Eng): quick q — is this driven by capacity limits or correctness requirements?
Priya (PM): both. customer wants per-tenant rollback + cost-aware routing when Dedicated capacity is low. also need an audit trail for compliance.
Jordan (CS): this came from Acme Corp. They hit a failover where fallback model changed outputs significantly. they want deterministic rollback to previous model version per customer.
Mira (SRE): fyi we already have per-route config, not per-tenant. implementing per-tenant routing is non-trivial for stateful cache.
Sam (Product): propose goals: 1) per-customer model pinning with canary windows, 2) automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variant under capacity pressure, 3) audit logs for rollouts. Non-goals: global config overhaul, long-term billing model changes.
Tess (Design): will need UX in Console: a simple dropdown to pin version, and a timeline view for rollouts.
Alex (Eng): acceptance criteria draft: - API to set tenant.pin_model(model_id, version) accepted by control plane and enforced for 99% of requests in <10s; - rollback action triggers version switch within SLO; - automated fallback uses routing-policy with cost threshold and doesn't silently change model for pinned tenants.
Priya (PM): add success metrics: - reduce customer-reported model-regression incidents by 90% for pinned tenants; - <1% increase in avg latency for pinned requests; - rollout audit events written within 2s of action.
Jordan (CS): edge case: what if pinned model is incompatible with new API-level features (e.g., streaming vs non-streaming)? We need to surface incompatibilities at pin time.
Alex (Eng): agreed. add validation step when pinning: if model_variant.missing_capabilities intersects tenant.required_capabilities -> reject with error code.
Mira (SRE): another edge: cache pollution if tenants move between variants often. acceptance criteria should require KV cache isolation plan or TTL safeguards.
Sam (Product): non-goal: perfect cache isolation. but must include mitigation: per-tenant cache namespaces + configurable TTLs.
Tess (Design): can we show cache impact in Console? small graph per-tenant cache hit-rate for 24h after pin change.
Priya (PM): good. also need rollout policy types: immediate, staged (percent-based), time-window. define default: staged 5/20/50/100 over 24h.
Alex (Eng): implementation notes: control plane stores tenant_pin records, router consults pin map; need fast invalidation path when pin changes. may need hot-reload with <5s propagation.
Mira (SRE): infra constraint: Dedicated pools may not have the requested model compiled. fallback plan: attempt compile, if compile >30m -> notify and keep earlier version for pinned tenant. document in RFC.
Jordan (CS): customer asks for SLA on rollbacks. can we commit to an SLO? probably need legal review.
Priya (PM): add launch criteria: - API + Console UX implemented; - automated tests for pin + rollback; - docs and runbook for ops; - sign-off from security and contracts for SLA language.
Alex (Eng): estimate: 4 sprints for core control plane + router hooks, 2 sprints for Console + QA. that assumes we reuse existing routing infra.
Sam (Product): prioritization: tag as P1 for customers on Dedicated with enterprise contracts; P2 for hosted customers.
Priya (PM): next steps: I'll draft the PRD with problem statement, goals, non-goals, acceptance criteria, and edge cases. Alex and Mira — can you add short tech notes to the RFC by EOD Wednesday? Jordan/Tess — I'll sync on console mocks and customer comms.

Priya (PM): thanks all — ping me on urgent blockers. planning a walkthrough Friday 10am. :calendar:
